dsh-deepseek-usage-dashboard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-41da9182abb6d948fa29.html
